common.name: home role
common.why: The launcher holds the HOME role, so Home opens it.

common.name: Google TV home off
common.why: Google TV's own home is disabled for user 0, or it takes Home back (pm enable undoes it).

common.name: setup recovery off
common.why: Google TV's setup recovery is disabled, or it brings Google TV's home back after an update.

common.name: usage stats
common.why: Lets the launcher know which app is in front.

common.name: overlay
common.why: Lets the launcher show its notices over other apps and open the home from the background.

common.name: TV listings
common.why: Lets the launcher read Android's Watch Next (the hero and Continuar assistindo).

common.name: notification listener
common.why: Lets the launcher show notifications and the playing track.

tv.name: secure settings (the launcher turns its console watcher back on)
tv.why: Lets the launcher turn its accessibility service back on when the TV drops it.

tv.name: console watcher
tv.why: The launcher's accessibility service: on a TCL it reads the input screen to see a console rest, and the sleep timer asks it for standby. It filters no keys.
tv.fix: settings put secure enabled_accessibility_services {pkg}/{pkg}.LauncherAccessibilityService; settings put secure accessibility_enabled 1

tv.name: keep activities
tv.why: Developer option "Don't keep activities" off: on, Android destroys the home's screen whenever an app opens and every app's screen when it is left, so they come back rebuilt (TV-C7K.md, "Measuring").

tv.name: system screensaver off
tv.why: The launcher's own screensaver is the one in use.

tv.name: screensaver on sleep off
tv.why: The launcher's own screensaver is the one in use.
